papers.title_en: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps
papers.evidence: 庞特里亚金最大值原理与深度学习结合求解随机控制
papers.tldr: 针对高维连续时间随机控制及跳跃扩散，提出深度Pontryagin学习框架，避免对离散动力学反复求导。方法先固定Markov控制，沿模拟轨迹反传奖励得到路径伴随标签，再回归投影到状态空间。随后依据逐点Hamiltonian平稳条件更新控制，并证明投影伴随满足离散Pontryagin原理且收敛到连续时间伴随BSDE。数值实验显示精度、稳定性与可扩展性良好。
papers.abstract_en: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

papers.authors: Karthik Prakhya, Zimeng Wang, Alp Yurtsever
papers.evidence: 约束凸优化的原始-对偶自适应次梯度方法
papers.tldr: 约束凸优化中步长选择与问题光滑性往往未知，给原始-对偶方法的收敛保证带来困难。本文提出自适应原始-对偶次梯度框架：首个方法在对偶侧采用AdaGrad步长，并通过平均Fenchel型oracle输出恢复原始解。理论表明，非光滑情形下对偶目标残差、原始目标残差与可行性间隙均达Õ(T^{-1/2})，对偶目标光滑时自动改进为O(T^{-1})。加速变体保留非光滑Õ(T^{-1/2})速率，并在温和假设下将光滑速率提升至O(T^{-2})；这些保证无需先验正则性知识，且在最优传输与Max-Cut半定松弛上得到实证验证。
papers.abstract_en: We propose adaptive primal-dual subgradient methods for constrained convex optimization. Our first method applies an AdaGrad-style step-sizes to the dual problem and recovers primal solutions by averaging the associated Fenchel-type oracle outputs. It achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence for the dual objective residual, primal objective residual, and feasibility gap in the nonsmooth regime, while automatically improving to $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ when the dual objective is smooth. We further develop an accelerated variant, which retains the $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/2})$ nonsmooth rate while achieving $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2})$ convergence in the smooth regime under mild assumptions. These guarantees require no prior knowledge of the underlying regularity. We demonstrate the empirical performance of the proposed methods on optimal transport and semidefinite relaxation of the Max-Cut problem.

papers.title_en: Fast Motion Retargeting Pipeline for Scalable Humanoid Robot Learning
papers.authors: Daniel Marew, Sangjun Park, Nisal Perera, Donghyun Kim
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人学习的并行分块重定向流水线
papers.tldr: 人体动捕数据可为机器人学习提供示范，但多动作跨本体重定向仍受限于昂贵优化与逐动作调参。FRDV 结合快速约束运动学重定向与动力学验证：用自定义 SQP、Real-Time Iteration 和分块并行，最高达 9,156 帧/秒，较 GMR、ProtoMotions 约快 136 倍；再用接触隐式 iLQR 在完整刚体动力学下筛查并修正脚滑、脚浮。该流程降低重定向伪影，并通过运动跟踪 RL 与 Unitree G1 实机迁移验证可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale human motion capture datasets provide a rich source of demonstrations for humanoid robot learning, retargeting the diverse motions to different humanoid robots remains a nontrivial challenge. Existing kinodynamic trajectory optimization pipelines are computationally expensive and often require manual adjustments per motion. We present FRDV (Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation), a scalable framework consisting of rapid constrained kinematic retargeting and an additional dynamics validation pipeline. Its kinematic stage integrates a custom Sequential Quadratic Programming solver, Real-Time Iteration, and parallel chunk-based processing, achieving up to 9,156 frames per second, approximately up to 136 times faster than GMR and ProtoMotions, while robot-specific constraints are incorporated into the optimization to reduce common retargeting artifacts, such as ground penetration and self-collision. For motions requiring additional verification, a contact implicit iLQR controller is utilized to test the retargeted reference under full rigid body dynamics. This dynamics-based validation identifies dynamically infeasible motions and refines contact-related artifacts such as foot floating and foot skating. We evaluate retargeting quality by training motion tracking reinforcement learning policies using several state-of-the-art pipelines and comparing their tracking fidelity and success rates. Furthermore, sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Videos and code are available at: https://daroslab.github.io/frdv/.

papers.title_en: Manifold Generative Annealing for Contact Constraint-aware Impedance Control with Reinforcement Learning Prior
papers.authors: Zhilin He, Guoquan Qi, Changliu Liu
papers.evidence: 结合强化学习先验的无模型与基于模型运动阻抗优化
papers.tldr: 接触丰富任务需在不确定交互与物理约束下协调运动与阻抗，但学习策略在接触变化时易失效，生成式优化也缺少结构化引导。为此提出MGA，将预训练强化学习策略组织为序列提案，经模型rollout评估、细化与选择，并以实现感知流形细化对齐约束几何和局部接触响应。在表面扫描、插孔与人形推搡实验中，MGA在名义及传感偏移下提升阻抗控制安全成功率。其贡献是将无模型先验与基于模型生成退火结合，实现变化接触下的在线运动—阻抗优化。
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich robotic tasks require coordinated motion and impedance under uncertain interaction dynamics and physical constraints. While recent methods on learned policies provide useful interaction strategies, they may fail when contact conditions differ from those encountered during training. Model-based generative methods show promising receding-horizon trajectories optimization results, but often lack structured behavioral guidance and refinement that jointly accounts for constraint geometry and actual contact responses. To this end, we propose Manifold Generative Annealing (MGA), a joint model-free and model-based generative framework for motion--impedance optimization. MGA first organizes pretrained reinforcement learning policies into structured sequence proposals, retaining task-specific interaction strategies without committing to their execution. It then evaluates these proposals alongside exploratory samples through model-based rollouts for refinement or separate execution selection. Crucially, realization-aware manifold refinement aligns updates from the refinement bank with both task constraints and locally achievable physical responses, allowing learned experience to guide online adaptation under changing contact conditions. Experiments cover surface scanning, peg insertion, and humanoid pushing, with improved safety success rate of impedance control under nominal and sensing-shift conditions.

papers.title_en: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.authors: Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Junsong Wu, Weiji Xie, Qingyao Xu, Sheng Yin, Shiqing Wang, Jiyuan Shi, Siheng Chen, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 将人类自我中心示范转换为人形机器人全身运动训练数据
papers.tldr: 人类第一视角示范可扩展，但视角错位、动作稀疏，人形全身VLA训练仍依赖昂贵机器人数据。KODA先优化生成仿真校验的全身轨迹，据此合成机器人视角观测并形成规范记录，再为不同控制器生成状态动作监督。在Unitree G1四项任务及SONIC、HEFT控制器上，机器人数据固定时，示范覆盖但机器人数据缺失条件的成功率分别提升45.0和46.25个百分点。该工作实现可复用、跨控制器的示范数据对齐，为规模化人形VLA学习提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

papers.title_en: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
papers.authors: Tianqi Liu, Hanfei Zhao, Qifeng Liang, Hui En Pang, Jiarui Xu, Sayang Mu, Penghao Qiu, YingSheng Zhang, Jun Wang, Ziang Cao, Mingze Sun, Yukang Cao, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu
papers.evidence: 跨人类与机器人具身的大规模移动操作世界模型
papers.tldr: 跨具身移动-操作世界模型受异构动作空间与多模态监督不足制约。Ropedia W0 构建首个覆盖人类与多机器人的第一视角移动-操作世界基础模型，汇集1万小时人类与3千小时机器人数据，并用统一运动学表示编码相机位姿与投影骨架。模型在五个跨具身基准及留出人类视频上取得领先，蒸馏后支持实时分钟级推演与VR交互，验证人类经验缩放对机器人和人类评测的迁移价值。
papers.abstract_en: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

papers.title_en: Bayesian Neural Networks via Dirichlet Process Priors on the Data-Generating Distribution for Randomized Value Functions in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 深度强化学习中的随机化价值函数与不确定性
papers.tldr: 标准贝叶斯神经网络在权重空间设先验，后验高维难采样，常用近似推断在强化学习中常低估 epistemic uncertainty。论文改为在数据生成分布上放置 Dirichlet Process 先验，构建 DP-BNN，并据此提出 DP-DQN 维护价值函数后验、执行 Thompson sampling。该方法用 Bayesian Bootstrap 做数据驱动后验重加权，并通过 DP 基测度注入生成式先验假设，单网络即可实现深度探索。贡献在于将随机化价值函数置于贝叶斯非参数框架，避免多网络集成开销。
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) offer a principled framework for quantifying epistemic uncertainty. However, standard weight-space priors yield complex, high-dimensional neural network posteriors that are computationally prohibitive to sample from, and popular approximate inference schemes often fail to capture epistemic uncertainty effectively---a failure mode particularly acute in reinforcement learning (RL) \citep{osband2018randomized}. To resolve this challenge, we introduce a new class of BNNs that quantify uncertainty by placing Bayesian nonparametric Dirichlet Process (DP) priors directly on the underlying data-generating distribution rather than on network parameters. Building on this foundation, we develop DP-DQN, a reinforcement learning algorithm that leverages DP-BNNs to maintain posterior distributions over value functions and perform efficient Thompson sampling. By grounding randomized value functions in Bayesian nonparametrics, DP-DQN unifies data-driven posterior reweighting (via the Bayesian Bootstrap) with generative prior hypotheses injected directly through the DP base measure, enabling decisive ``deep exploration'' with a single neural network without the overhead of multi-network ensembles.

papers.title_en: Universal Online Convex Optimization With Delayed Feedback
papers.authors: Hao Qiu, Andrew Jacobsen, Emmanuel Esposito, Mengxiao Zhang
papers.evidence: 曲率自适应的通用在线凸优化算法
papers.tldr: 延迟反馈在线凸优化通常需预知损失曲率。本文提出单一通用算法，用带二阶超额损失保证的延迟元学习器自适应聚合延迟基学习器，无需先验即可适应一般凸、强凸和 exp-concave 损失。其后悔界在最多双对数因子内匹配最佳依赖：凸损失约 sqrt(T+d_tot)，曲率损失为 σ_max log T 量级。新基学习器以 σ_max 替代最大延迟并保留 sqrt(d_tot) 项，改进延迟依赖。
papers.abstract_en: We study universal online convex optimization with delayed feedback. We develop a single algorithm that simultaneously adapts to general convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave losses without prior knowledge of the curvature class or parameters. Our regret bounds match the best known dependence on the time horizon $T$ and delays up to doubly logarithmic factors: roughly $\sqrt{T + d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ for convex losses and $σ_{\max}\log T$ rates with curved losses, where $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the total cumulative delay and $σ_{\max}$ is the maximum number of simultaneously missing observations. Our main technical contribution is a delayed meta-learner with a second-order excess-loss guarantee, which enables curvature-adaptive aggregation of delayed base learners. In addition, our new exp-concave base learner yields a sharper regret bound which improves the state-of-the-art delay dependence by replacing the maximum delay with the potentially much smaller $σ_{\max}$, while retaining the complementary $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence.

papers.title_en: Temporal Difference Learning of Probabilistic Reach-Avoid Value Functions
papers.authors: Elias Fontanari, Pietro Noah Crestaz, Matteo Saveriano, Andrea Del Prete
papers.evidence: 随机扰动下的概率可达-规避价值学习
papers.tldr: 在随机扰动环境中，传统Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析把扰动当作最坏情况，得到的可达-规避集偏保守，且需预先知道扰动范围。本文提出概率可达-规避值函数（PVF），一种适用于黑盒系统的自监督方法，将可达-规避集定义为在随机且可能无界扰动下达到指定成功概率的状态。在复杂度递增的系统上，直到Hopper运动任务，PVF给出的概率集合比对抗式HJR基线更不保守、更准确，可用于机器人部署与运行时任务可行性监测。
papers.abstract_en: Reach-avoid sets, defining the states from which a task can be completed while avoiding unsafe regions, are fundamental tools for deploying robots in environments subject to disturbances and uncertainty, as well as for runtime task-feasibility monitoring, allowing prediction of whether a state is safe and will lead to successful task completion. Classical Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability (HJR) and its recent neural extensions (e.g., Lipschitz Continuous Reachability Learning, DeepReach) treat disturbances adversarially, computing the reach-avoid set under worst-case disturbances from a bounded set. This guarantees safety but can yield overly conservative sets when disturbances are stochastic rather than adversarial, and additionally requires the disturbance set to be known or specified in advance.   We propose Probabilistic reach-avoid Value Function (PVF), a self-supervised method, applicable to black-box systems, for computing reach-avoid sets as the states with a certain reach-avoid probability under stochastic, potentially unbounded disturbances. We evaluate our approach against HJR-based baselines on systems of increasing complexity, up to a Hopper locomotion task, and show that our probabilistic sets are less conservative and more accurate than adversarial HJR sets when disturbances are non-adversarial.

papers.title_en: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
papers.authors: Martin Hernandez, Xinyan Qing, Mo Zhou, Yuhua Zhu
papers.evidence: 含收敛性与价值函数分析的策略梯度理论
papers.tldr: 连续时间强化学习需在未知随机微分方程下仅用离散观测学习最优策略。本文建立策略梯度框架，给出性能差分引理及随机化/参数化策略梯度公式，并证明熵正则策略流指数收敛。针对离散参数更新，收敛界显式分离评论家误差、策略回归误差与步长影响，并结合PhiBE从离散转移数据构造代理生成器。由此提出保持连续时间结构的无模型on/off-policy actor-critic算法，在LQR与轮式机器人实验中验证稳定性与性能。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time reinforcement learning seeks an optimal policy under unknown dynamics driven by stochastic differential equations using observations collected at discrete times. We develop a policy gradient framework that combines rigorous convergence analysis with learning from discrete data. We first establish a performance difference lemma and derive policy gradient formulas for randomized and parametrized policies. We then prove exponential convergence of an entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum. For discrete parametrized updates, we derive a convergence bound that explicitly separates the contributions of critic error, policy-regression error, and the learning step size. To enable learning under unknown dynamics, we integrate this framework with PhiBE, which constructs a continuous-time surrogate generator from discrete transition data. The resulting on-policy and off-policy model-free actor-critic algorithms preserve the continuous-time structure of the control problem. Numerical experiments on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot demonstrate the performance and stability of the proposed methods with both known and data-driven dynamics.

papers.title_en: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
papers.authors: Hao Bai, Jiarui Yao, Tong Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合逐token重要性采样与KL正则的策略优化
papers.tldr: 离线策略RLVR中，token级重要性加权可避免整段似然比相乘，却会带来策略梯度偏差。作者证明完整未来KL信用使精确近端优化器成为更新目标的唯一平稳策略，并提出Proximal KL：分离近端参考与采样策略，用有界未来KL信用替代PPO裁剪。七组匹配离线对比中，Qwen3-1.7B/4B八项数学基准微平均准确率最高超GRPO 2.58%，周期刷新下避免PG/CISPO崩溃且更新更少。
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.

papers.title_en: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.authors: Huixuan Cheng, Bike Zhang, Shankar Sastry, Koushil Sreenath
papers.evidence: 人形控制策略权重的生成式建模
papers.tldr: 人形控制网络通常只通过训练获得，其权重分布建模与权空间生成仍少被研究。本文用线性自编码器压缩actor参数，并以Diffusion Transformer建模潜变量分布，构建人形策略权重的潜在扩散框架。在Unitree G1的强化学习网络上训练后，生成网络可真实部署并完成行走、舞蹈和回旋踢等动作。作者还发现首层权重持续体现机器人运动学先验，且该先验在RL与IL下均出现，为理解人形具身知识提供线索。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

papers.title_en: Optimization of a Perturbed Implicit Sweeping Process by Constrained Discontinuous Controls
papers.authors: Yen Dang, Boris S. Mordukhovich, Dao Nguyen
papers.evidence: 含凸约束的非光滑微分包含最优控制
papers.tldr: 本文研究受约束不连续控制驱动的扰动隐式扫掠过程最优控制，其动力学由移动凸多面体法锥构成的速度相关微分包含描述。针对状态、速度与约束反力隐式耦合的非光滑难题，采用离散逼近并结合变分分析与广义微分工具。先在离散时间问题中推导局部极小点的必要性最优条件，再取极限得到原连续时间系统的最优性条件。结果将扫掠过程最优控制理论推广到状态与速度依赖约束的隐式动力系统。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal control problems governed by an implicit sweeping process with velocity-dependent constraint geometry, where the dynamics are described by a differential inclusion involving the normal cone to a moving convex polyhedral set. Such systems form a challenging class of nonsmooth differential inclusions due to the implicit coupling between the state, velocity, and constraint reaction. To address these difficulties, we use a method of discrete approximations together with tools of variational analysis and generalized differentiation. This approach allows us to derive necessary optimality conditions for local minimizer in discrete-time problems and subsequently pass to the limit to obtain optimality conditions for the original continuous-time system. The obtained results extend existing optimal control theory for sweeping processes to a class of implicit dynamical systems with state-and velocity-dependent constraints.

papers.title_en: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.authors: Tianjiao Yu, Zhilin Ou, Yifan Shen, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Onkar Kishor Susladkar, Fan Wang, Ismini Lourentzou
papers.evidence: 生成式仿真数据引擎与机器人动作策略协同演化
papers.tldr: 生成式仿真能自动构建机器人环境，但物理有效并不等于适合训练。CoDA 让数据引擎与动作策略通过共享异构记忆协同演化，将视觉语言评论器验证的诊断编译成环境生成与训练程序，并用 Text2potential 把诊断转为分阶段势函数以提供密集价值监督。在四类操作任务中，其分布外成功率由监督微调后的5.3%升至27.6%，同预算下超过最强闭环基线9.5个百分点；LIBERO-Pro上位置与指令扰动成功率分别从25%和1%升至84%和76%。
papers.abstract_en: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

papers.title_en: Synthesis of the Transient Behaviour of Optimization Algorithms for Strongly Convex Objective Functions
papers.authors: Adel Abdelsamed, Dennis Gramlich, Christian Ebenbauer, Carsten W. Scherer
papers.evidence: 借助鲁棒H2控制构造凸半定规划分析优化算法
papers.tldr: 针对光滑强凸目标下的一阶优化算法，研究其有限时间瞬态性能。将算法视为嵌入梯度非线性反馈的有限时域线性系统，并用离散时间Zames-Falb积分二次约束刻画目标函数类。基于鲁棒H2控制框架构造凸半定规划，认证终端距离的紧最坏情况界，并综合瞬态最优算法。该方法还自然扩展到梯度测量延迟情形，为有限时域性能分析与算法设计提供统一、可计算的凸优化框架。
papers.abstract_en: We study the transient behavior of first-order optimization methods for unconstrained minimization of smooth and strongly convex objective functions. These methods are modelled as linear systems over finite-time intervals embedded in feedback with the gradient nonlinearity. By characterizing the function class through discrete-time Zames-Falb integral quadratic constraints, we employ a robust $\mathcal{H}_2$ control framework to obtain convex semidefinite programs certifying tight worst-case bounds on the terminal distance to the optimizer. Building on the same formulation, we derive a convex synthesis procedure for a transient-optimal method that achieves the optimal finite-horizon bounds and guarantees error reduction over any prescribed number of steps. The framework naturally extends to delayed gradient measurements, enabling both transient performance analysis and synthesis of optimal algorithms under feedback delays.

papers.title_en: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Zicheng Liu, Haochen Wu, Jiawei He, Suyun Zhao, Huan Yang, Cheng Chi, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人协作的自演化可执行代码策略
papers.tldr: 多机器人人形协作受单体形态限制，现有框架难在物理执行偏离时自适应协调。CoEvolve将团队协调表示为固定运动技能上的可执行代码，并用验证器引导多模态模型演化策略、从检查点修正被拒行为。两个Unitree G1搬运刚性载荷实验中，15次基础任务完成8次，三类多模态骨干均实现端到端成功。结果表明可执行协调可作为共享物理约束下长程多机器人协作的实用接口。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

papers.title_en: SocialCoAct: Enabling and Benchmarking Egocentric Social Co-Action for VLM-Based Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Jiancong Ma, Kun Li, Jin Jiang, Shengcai Liao
papers.evidence: 基于VLM的人形机器人社交协同动作
papers.tldr: 现有方法多将预生成语音直接映射为连续动作轨迹，对复杂社交环境感知有限且缺少显式高层语义动作规划。SocialCoAct 提出以智能体为中心的统一框架，把第一视角观察与对话历史转为语音回应和原子动作序列，实现话语与动作对齐并在 MuJoCo 和实体机器人上执行。配套基准含 423 道人工校验题，最佳 VLM 总体准确率 77.54%，困难子集仅 46.51%。
papers.abstract_en: Enabling humanoid robots to participate effectively in social interactions is important for their integration into human-centered environments. Existing methods, however, typically map pre-generated speech directly to continuous motion trajectories but have limited awareness of complex social environments and lack explicit high-level semantic action planning. We introduce SocialCoAct, a unified agent-centered framework for VLM-based egocentric social co-action. We formulate egocentric social co-action as an end-to-end agent task and develop SocialCoAct-Agent, which transforms egocentric observations and dialogue history into verbal responses and atomic action sequences, aligns each action with its corresponding utterance span, and executes the resulting behaviors in MuJoCo and on a physical humanoid robot. To evaluate the VLM capabilities required by this task, we construct SocialCoAct-Bench from continuous egocentric recordings of natural multi-party interactions. The benchmark comprises 423 human-verified multiple-choice questions across three subtasks: Long Episode Understanding (LEU), Speaker Intention Understanding (SIU), and Coordinated Action Planning (CAP). Across a diverse set of closed-source and open-weight VLMs, including general and egocentric models, the highest overall accuracy is 77.54%, while accuracy on the hard subset reaches only 46.51%. Extended reasoning improves Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B by 19.62 and 17.02 percentage points, respectively, but reduces inference throughput by 53.6$\times$ and 20.2$\times$. Visual-input ablations further show that the benefits of visual context vary across models. SocialCoAct provides a foundation for developing and evaluating VLM-based humanoid agents that coordinate context-aware speech and action in complex social interactions. The codebase and benchmark will be made publicly available upon publication.
